title: KATAS
description: A 3D Isshin Ryu kata viewer: step through Seisan, Seiunchin, Naihanchi, Wansu, and Chinto on an animated avatar with a scrubbable timeline, camera presets, a bunkai attacker overlay, and a browser coach voice. A Travel Schooling class: sign in at the portal, and stepping through a kata earns XP.
